brief: A two-storey garage tower sturdy enough that it will never wobble or crack with tins of screws in it.

requirements.evidence: 3 full bases level 0 (piece:0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,1,0) + 3 full bases level 1 with snaps; all joints bolted with jointBolts and side connectors, capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied

requirements.requirement: Garage storage for tins of screws
requirements.evidence: 3 top bins: bin:0,0,1 full, bin:0,1,1 div2, bin:1,0,1 full dressed with heap-screws-bin, heap-screws-div2, heap-nuts-div2 props

requirements.requirement: Sturdy enough that it will never wobble or crack under tins of screws
requirements.evidence: Compact 3-cell triangular tower, all walls joint-bolted, side-connector-double between cells both storeys, lockJoints run, check_build ok meshClash clear. But configurator checks fit/collision only and knows nothing about strength, load ratings, cracking or materials (user-chosen print material) so absolute never-wobble/never-crack cannot be guaranteed

finish.summary: Two-storey 3+3 cell garage tower, fully bolted and locked, with 3 top bins dressed with screw/nut heaps. Strength guarantee is partial: shape is braced but load/material safety is outside the configurator.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
